Home.title: Move to Green with Motorcare
Home.content:
It's our ambition to be a green company and move people to green transportation solutions.

One of our standout initiatives is the introduction of fully electric vehicles across all our brands. In a market where electric vehicles are still emerging, we've been pioneers in bringing this environmentally friendly option through our move to green campaign, reducing the carbon footprint of our offerings.

About.info: At the forefront of automotive solutions in Mozambique since 1996

Motorcare has been providing automotive services to businesses in Mozambique since 1996.
As an authorized distributor of premium brands, Motorcare delivers excellent automotive solutions, including genuine parts and accessories, as well as specialized maintenance and repair services, complemented by a full range of fleet management solutions.
Motorcare's national presence extends to the cities of Maputo, Beira, Nampula, Pemba, and Moatize.
Motorcare aims to grow its business profitably and responsibly, promoting social and environmental goals aligned with international standards and certifications.

MOTORCARE provides quality Sales and After-Sales Services through its national network of branches strategically located in Maputo, Moatize, Nampula, Pemba and Biera to ensure quality solutions to your business needs.

We offer a wide range of technologically advanced tyres, competitive pricing and quality service without compromise of safety. Trust the MOTORCARE fitment professionals to provide you the best tyre solutions in Mozambique.

Be it the hardcore Grabber GT and Grabber AT tyre for rock, sand and mud or the comfort and speed of the Altimax Comfort and Altimax Sport. With MOTORCARE and GENERAL TIRE anywhere is possible.

About.cst: Motorcare also has one of the best tire companies. Utilising a first-rate manufacturing operation and highly efficient logistics, CST sets the standard for excellence in the tire industry.
About.history_info: MOTORCARE Mozambique was founded in 1996 by the KJAER GROUP, a Danish company that provides transport solutions in over 70 countries. Motorcare Mozambique's passion and commitment to delivering high-quality transportation and complete vehicle solutions have solidified its position in the emerging transportation market. We are present in Maputo, Beira, Nampula, Moatize, and Pemba.
About.1996-info: Motorcare starts operations in Mozambique, in Matola.
About.2000-info: Relocation of headquarters from Matola to Maputo.
About.2008-info: Opening of branches in Beira and Nampula.
About.2014-info: Launch of new facilities in Moatize and Pemba.
About.2023-info: Restructuring and upgrading of Maputo, Beira, and Nampula branches.
About.certification_info: Motorcare provides services and products in accordance with international standards for health, safety, environment, and quality. Therefore, it has an Integrated Management System based on three international standards: ISO 45001 (Health & Safety), ISO 14001 (Environment), and ISO 9001 (Quality), which are audited annually both internally and externally by an international body. ISO 14001 is an international standard that allows companies to demonstrate their commitment to environmental protection by managing the environmental risks associated with their activities. ISO 9001 aims to ensure greater quality in product or service delivery, focusing on the company's strategic management. This enables improved operational efficiency and Customer Satisfaction.

tireReplacement.title: Do I need to replace my tires?
tireReplacement.name: The consumer plays an important role in tire maintenance
tireReplacement.description: Tires should be replaced for various reasons, including tread wear to the minimum depth or damage (punctures, cuts, impacts, bulges, inflation, overloading, etc.). For these reasons, tires, including spare parts, should be routinely inspected, i.e., at least once a month. Regular inspection becomes particularly important the longer a tire is kept in use. If tire damage is suspected, Continental recommends that the consumer have the tire checked by a professional. Consumers should use this consultation to determine whether tires can continue to be used. It is recommended that spare tires be inspected at the same time. This routine inspection should occur whether or not the vehicle is equipped with a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS). Consumers are strongly encouraged to be aware of the visual condition of their tires. In addition, they should be alert to any changes in dynamic performance, such as increased air loss, noise or vibration. Such changes may be an indicator that one or more of the tires should be removed from use immediately to prevent tire failure.

tireCare.title: Tire care considerations
tireCare.name: Main requirements
tireCare.description: There are a number of considerations we should take into account when buying tires, but let's start with some important considerations. The first is the tire size? Well, this can be found on the sidewall information and will be something like 205/55 R16. The next important consideration comes right after the size and is the tire's 'service description'. Actually, there are two pieces of information which are the tire's load and speed ratings. These can also be found on the sidewall information and consist of a number and a letter that relate to industry tables, meaning there is consistency across all tire brands. Now we know the size and service description we need now to look at other considerations.

tireMaintenance.title: Tire care considerations
tireMaintenance.name: Why is tire maintenance important?
tireMaintenance.description: The consumer plays an important role in tire maintenance. Tires may need to be replaced for various reasons, including tread wear to the minimum depth, or damage (punctures, cuts, impacts, cracks, bulges, inflation, overloading, etc.). For these reasons, tires, including spare parts, should be routinely inspected, i.e., at least once a month. Regular inspection becomes particularly important the longer a tire is kept in use. If tire damage is suspected, Continental recommends that the consumer have the tire checked by a professional. Consumers should use this consultation to determine whether tires can continue in service. It is recommended that spare tires be inspected at the same time. This routine inspection should occur whether or not the vehicle is equipped with a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS). Consumers are strongly encouraged to be aware of the visual condition of their tires. In addition, they should be alert to any changes in dynamic performance, such as increased air loss, noise or vibration. Such changes may be an indicator that one or more of the tires should be removed immediately to prevent tire deficiency.

bestInBraking.headline: Best in braking. Best in know-how
bestInBraking.title: Curiosity is our main driver.
bestInBraking.description: Continental understands the world's roads – and how to brake on them. Every day, we put our passion and experience into developing our innovations. Manufacturing only with high-quality materials, we are setting standards with every new product. How? By applying the knowledge from our innovations to every new design: Our high-performance tires give us deep insight into how to develop a safer driving experience for daily use. The technology used in Conti.eContact will help ordinary cars become more efficient in the future. The ContiSeal principle has moved from paper to being unstoppable on the streets. Some examples of why Continental is one of the best in Braking. Just one reason for this: We never stop exploring.

whyContinental.headline: Why Continental
whyContinental.title: We strive for nothing less than excellence.
whyContinental.description: Since its founding in 1871, Continental has worked with one goal: To bring safety to roads without compromising comfort and driving pleasure. From the world's first tire with tread patterns to the visionary Conti.eContact and our innovations in automotive safety – for over 140 years, we have been constantly developing our experiences in mobility, transport and processing. And while you read this, more than 200,000 highly qualified employees in 53 countries are working towards this goal.

germanTechnology.headline: German Technology
germanTechnology.title: Learn from the past, Reach for the future
germanTechnology.description: German engineering and precision is legendary, as the inventors of the world's first tire with tread patterns, Continental seeks to prove this inventive spirit with every new product. Our engineering experience center can be found in Hanover, Germany. The research center with its huge test race track and international renown, the Contidrom brings together the expertise of more than 1000 dedicated scientists, engineers and designers in Europe and the United States. And each new test follows a simple purpose: to make driving safer, all of course according to the highest German standards – for over 140 years and counting.

testedForSafety.headline: Tested for your Safety
testedForSafety.title: Defining standards in standards.
testedForSafety.description: Before any Continental Innovation goes into production it is tested intensively. The established test methods ensure daily suitability. Continental uses and develops more advanced test measurement technology to provide mature and optimized products. We Test for your safety- worldwide. Throughout the year we repeatedly show that there are no limits to our tire tests, at our test sites in the United States, New Zealand, Sweden, Spain and last but not least at our internal track near Hanover, the Contidrom – which is also a reference track sought after by independent experts. Each of our winter and summer tires from around the world is tested under all kinds of weather conditions and road surface conditions. Needless to say, all this happens with the most modern test methods and measurement technology.

automotiveExperience.headline: Automotive Experience
automotiveExperience.title: Looking ahead and further
automotiveExperience.description: Since 1995, Continental has already developed important technologies for safety and better driving comfort. Now it's up to us to shape the future of the automobile. The Continental Automotive Group is one of the world's leading automotive suppliers, with more than 87,000 employees in over 170 locations. All of them work in a unique configuration from tires to advanced safety systems with a common vision: To make mobility safe, sustainable and interconnected. As cars get smarter, our three Chassis & Safety, Powertrain and Interior work together to use this data for a better driving experience. From active and passive safety, data and fuel management to the driver's eye, Continental covers the entire car driving process and maybe one day let it drive itself.

originalEquipment.headline: Original Equipment
originalEquipment.title: Believe in us. as the experts do..
originalEquipment.description: Start with the highest quality. Car manufacturers only use premium tires that meet the highest quality standards. We ensure that Continental tires meet all these standards. From maximum speed for braking on wet or dry asphalt, handling, confrontation and noise level as well as mileage: Our engineers perform more than 100 different tests, to ensure that an OE tire fits the vehicle – whether it's a sports car or a van. As a result, Continental is one of the leading equipment suppliers to car manufacturers worldwide; Almost one third of vehicles in Europe leave the factory with Continental tires. This makes us the first choice in Europe among initial equipment manufacturers- and very proud too. If the leading car manufacturers trust Continental, you can too.

independentTests.headline: Independent Tire Tests
independentTests.title: Approved Worldwide
independentTests.description: When developing our Premium tires, we consider every aspect of safety and performance. The result: maximum ratings for Continental tires – worldwide. Continental not only claims to produce world-class tires with the highest quality standard. We can also prove it: Our award-winning tires are regularly tested by international magazines. Since 2007, Continental products have received the highest recommendations in almost 80% of all tests. In addition, the company was voted the best tire brand by renowned car magazines such as AutoBild and Auto Zeitung and received the best tests of 50 years in motorsport. And our constant development of tires will maintain this tradition.

goAnywhere.title: It's possible to go Anywhere
goAnywhere.description: 100 Years of Adventures Whether driving on paved roads or navigating unknown territories in the desert. You can go anywhere with General Tire. With over 100 years of experience in the tire industry and as part of Continental- as a leading tire manufacturer based in Germany – General Tire offers products you can trust.
